title: TimeEvidence quality metadata is only shallowly immutable
description: Correctness review: MappingProxyType(dict(quality)) protects only the top-level mapping and retains mutable nested lists/dicts/objects. Mutating a nested value after issuance changes accepted evidence despite spec requiring immutable provenance. Recursively freeze/copy an explicitly allowed immutable metadata schema and add post-issuance nested-mutation regressions.
